errors.what: First quality_mutate pass: the '<' to '<=' mutant at the 7 ft/h wall boundary survived because the two ACI wall equations are continuous there
errors.fix: added a band-membership test; mutant now caught

doc_friction.issue: Says calculators are a poor use of a run while the explore prompt gives free choice and the construction direction asks for exactly this kind of engineering tool; the two pulled in opposite directions.
--skip-build ('the one-minute pass') took about 5 minutes here, past the 120 s tool timeout; had to rerun it in the background.
The long list of clean sweeps plus ~200 check_*.py files makes clear new audits are saturated; a line saying so up front ('prefer building over sweeping') would save the survey time.

deviations.why: 'Calculators are a poor use of a run'. Built a formwork pressure tool anyway: it picks the equation band, applies the caps and minimum, inverts a form's rating into a pour rate across a piecewise boundary and lays out ties, which a chatbot reply often gets wrong, and it fills a gap next to concrete-maturity in the owner's construction direction.
deviations.did: Shipped it as an engineering tool with hand-calculation tests and an explainer page
deviations.result: Merged with 29 tests; usage not yet measured
